scope: Requirement-derived development checks at current CachePort/Context/HTTP/client owners and actual native DevTools. Not phone, production Redis/PostgreSQL, official package/performance acceptance, full experience completion or independent review.

before.escapedDefect: Two real same-revision different time writes both succeeded in Memory and two independent Redis clients; durable readback retained only the second.

results: Memory and two independent real Redis clients: concurrent HTTP edits return one 200 and one 409, durable result equals the acknowledged winner, subsequent night edit and another instance readback preserve identity/expiry and update night fingerprint
Memory and Redis: storage expires between read and commit, update fails and cannot recreate the same Context
Memory and Redis: original cache TTL is retained, earlier absolute deadline is enforced, missing cache record is not recreated
Memory commit-boundary rejection and real Redis client disconnect: prior Context remains readable, valid reconnect/retry succeeds
storageAndHttp.fixtureRepair: Two early attempts failed during test cleanup because both app.close and the fixture retired the same Redis client. The fixture now delegates retirement once to the app. Final affected checks all passed; not a product concurrency failure.
